confirmation: Touch candle close on UTC-aligned native 4H or 1H boundaries; strict close back inside entry level
entry: First post-Monday touch per NY week and side; upper short, lower long; skip already-marketable submission
target: Opposite (farther) Monday high/low, resting from entry; original entry-week range retained
risk_unit: 1R = 1% of entry price before fees; stop rounded outward to actual tick
reclaimed: Actual maker entry fee plus taker exit fee, outward tick-rounded protective STOP_MARKET
failed_reclaim: Replace far target with maker-entry/maker-exit fee-neutral LIMIT; retain initial 1% backstop
reclaimed_inside_fee_band: Resting limit at maker-entry/taker-exit fee-neutral price while retaining 1% backstop; avoids crossed stop or marketable maker limit
intrabar_path: OHLC with monotone synthetic segments; not observed ticks
censoring: Source end or missing 5m path; administrative framework close excluded from realized results
controls: Same instrument, NY week, side and causal prior14-bar relative-TR bucket; scaled identical price geometry and execution policy; no resampling unfilled attempts
